purpose.summary: Add a closed, sanitized failure-role diagnostic contract for the bounded passive mainnet harness without changing its successful v2 report.
scope: Attribute each reportable child failure to exactly one closed phase role: baseline, candidate, comparison or harness.
Write a non-success report only after complete harness cleanup and revalidation of both input binary identities; retain no success observations in that report.
Keep child stdout and stderr suppressed while the reproduction driver validates the local failure report and emits only one closed diagnostic line.
Delete every report and receipt before the reproduction driver fails, including when the child report is absent, malformed or untrusted.
Preserve the successful ergon-mainnet-passive-smoke/v2 report contract and all existing source, signature, dependency, privacy and cleanup boundaries.
exclusions: No workflow, container, dependency-lock, production-node, consensus, validation, P2P, storage, RPC, wallet, Chronik, activation, testnet or mainnet-parameter change.
No network run, workflow dispatch, rerun, incoming artifact, evidence promotion or claim that either a success or diagnosed failure has been publicly reproduced.
No raw child output, exception text, peer address, absolute host path, parent environment, cookie, secret, port, datadir or runtime artifact is projected or retained.
No upload-on-failure path is added; a nonzero child result leaves the output directory empty and causes the existing workflow step to fail.
No current-tip, full-history, simultaneous-operation, peer-diversity, sustained-operation, deterministic-build, operator-binary or mainnet-coexistence claim.
The reproduction driver remains bound to ERGON-CHANGE-0018 until a later signed public commit can bind these new harness bytes without self-reference.

The mutable hosted runner image and operator binaries remain outside deterministic-build and operator-parity claims.
